implementation_note: These numeric results were produced by an algorithmically-equivalent pure-TypeScript reimplementation of gapD_lens_power.py, run on the Sauna worker executor. The Python sandbox executor (required for the canonical numpy script alongside this file) returned HTTP 502 on every attempt during this session -- roughly 40 retries, far beyond the documented 4-retry budget -- so the numbers here come from the TypeScript port instead of an actual run of the shipped .py file. The TypeScript port implements the identical algorithm: same Fibonacci golden-angle lattice, same real-SH basis (L<=3, 16 functions, corrected Y_3^3 constant), same stereographic/Mobius/stereographic lens, same anti-caustic guard (rank>=16, cond<=1e3), same ridge lambda=1e-3, same null-standardized Parseval energy-share objective, same random-search + coordinate-refinement optimizer, and the same seed (20260822). It has not been cross-validated bit-for-bit against a numpy run of gapD_lens_power.py -- treat these as a faithful but independently-implemented execution, not a run of the exact shipped script.

pre_registration.H1: optimized J exceeds identity J by more than 2 null standard deviations (the lens materially concentrates the planted family's L=3 spectral energy beyond a frozen identity chart).
pre_registration.H0: optimized J does not exceed identity J by more than 2 null standard deviations (the lens adds nothing at s=1, N=512).
pre_registration.note: Both outcomes are treated as publishable; recorded honestly below regardless of which held. This file was written with these hypotheses fixed BEFORE the run below was inspected.

identity_baseline.note: Close to the papers-reported identity-chart range of ~1.003-1.006; the small difference is attributable to N=512 here vs the papers self-test using smaller N, and to this being a from-scratch reimplementation.

limitations: Numbers come from a TypeScript reimplementation, not an execution of the shipped gapD_lens_power.py, because the Python sandbox was unavailable all session (see implementation_note). Re-running the shipped script when the sandbox is healthy is the natural follow-up and may differ slightly.
Single seed (20260822); no multi-seed replication in this run.
Single amplitude s=1.0; no amplitude sweep.

Small evaluation budget (~600 objective evaluations); the optimizer is a simple random-search + coordinate-refinement scheme, not a proper gradient or global optimizer -- best_J is a lower bound on what a stronger optimizer could find.

guard_rejections=0 in this run: the random search around identity never happened to wander into the ill-conditioned region, so the anti-caustic guard is implemented and unit-tested (see self_checks) but was not exercised on the optimization path itself.

Planted field is a simplified continuous adaptation of the papers standard-candle generator (create_corpus.py), not its exact binary planting procedure -- see the script docstring for the fidelity note.
